text.tspan: R ← D, an arbitrary 8 × 8 matrix over Z/2 (light blue = non-zero), V ← I. Columns are processed left to right.
low(j) is the lowest non-zero row of column j (dark blue once it becomes a pivot). Orange: current column. Green: column being added.
Column 1: low(1) = 5. No earlier column has its pivot in row 5: the column is reduced.
New pivot (5, 1).
Column 2: low(2) = 2. No earlier column has its pivot in row 2: the column is reduced.
New pivot (2, 2).
Column 3: low(3) = 8. No earlier column has its pivot in row 8: the column is reduced.
New pivot (8, 3).
Column 4: low(4) = 4. No earlier column has its pivot in row 4: the column is reduced.
New pivot (4, 4).
Column 5: low(5) = 4 collides with low(4) = 4.
Add column 4 to column 5 in R, and V[·, 4] to V[·, 5].
Column 5 is now {1, 2, 3}: low(5) = 3 is free, so the column is reduced.
New pivot (3, 5).
Column 6: low(6) = 7. No earlier column has its pivot in row 7: the column is reduced.
New pivot (7, 6).
Column 7: low(7) = 7 collides with low(6) = 7.
Add column 6 to column 7 in R, and V[·, 6] to V[·, 7].
Column 7 is now {1, 5} (dark gray = changed): low(7) = 5 collides with low(1) = 5 again.
Add column 1 to column 7 in R, and V[·, 1] to V[·, 7].
Column 7 is now {2, 4} (dark gray = changed): low(7) = 4 collides with low(4) = 4 again.
Add column 4 to column 7 in R, and V[·, 4] to V[·, 7].
Column 7 is now {3} (dark gray = changed): low(7) = 3 collides with low(5) = 3 again.
Add column 5 to column 7 in R, and V[·, 5] to V[·, 7].
Column 7 is now {1, 2} (dark gray = changed): low(7) = 2 collides with low(2) = 2 again.
Add column 2 to column 7 in R, and V[·, 2] to V[·, 7].
Column 7 has been reduced to zero: it has no pivot (a "positive" column).
Column 8: low(8) = 8 collides with low(3) = 8.
Add column 3 to column 8 in R, and V[·, 3] to V[·, 8].
Column 8 is now {1, 4, 5, 6}: low(8) = 6 is free, so the column is reduced.
New pivot (6, 8).
Done. Pivots: (5, 1), (2, 2), (8, 3), (4, 4), (3, 5), (7, 6), (6, 8). Zero columns: 7 (their V-columns are cycles).
Lazy: a column is touched only when its pivot collides with an earlier one. Worst case O(n³).

svg.text: while R[·, j] ≠ 0 and ∃ j′ < j with low(j′) = low(j):
▷ a column is reduced only when its pivot
